mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.tenant_id,s.candidate_id,s.position_id,s.version,s.status,s.payload,s.provenance,s.cache_key,s.created_by,s.created_at FROM ai_hr_interview_set s JOIN ai_hr_position p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.id=s.position_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.candidate_id=#{candidate} AND p.department_id IN #{d} AND p.id IN #{id} AND ((#{g.permission}='hr:position:read' AND p.department_id=#{g.departmentId} AND (#{g.positionId}='*' OR p.id=#{g.positionId}))) AND s.version=(SELECT MAX(v.version) FROM ai_hr_interview_set v WHERE v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.id=s.id) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC,s.id
SELECT FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND department_id IN AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at>#{now} AND id IN #{cid} ORDER BY acquired_at DESC,id
SELECT FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,resume_version_id,version,facts_json,created_by,created_at FROM ai_hr_fact_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT payload FROM ai_hr_policy_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}

SELECT FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id IN (SELECT source_candidate_id FROM ai_hr_candidate_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND primary_candidate_id=#{primary} AND status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY id

SELECT id,tenant_id,primary_candidate_id,source_ids,status,created_at,revocable_until,version,created_by FROM ai_hr_candidate_merge WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='ACTIVE' AND id IN (SELECT merge_id FROM ai_hr_candidate_source WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND source_candidate_id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,tenant_id,primary_candidate_id,source_ids,status,created_at,revocable_until,version,created_by FROM ai_hr_candidate_merge WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_hr_candidate_source(tenant_id,source_candidate_id,primary_candidate_id,merge_id,status) VALUES(#{tenant},#{source},#{primary},#{merge},'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE primary_candidate_id=VALUES(primary_candidate_id),merge_id=VALUES(merge_id),status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_candidate_merge SET status='REVOKED',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND version=#{version}
UPDATE ai_hr_candidate_source SET status='REVOKED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND merge_id=#{merge} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE ai_hr_interview_set SET status='STALE' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND provenance LIKE #{source} AND provenance LIKE '%,%' AND status='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,position_id,version,status,payload,provenance,cache_key,created_by,created_at FROM ai_hr_interview_set WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,position_id,version,status,payload,provenance,cache_key,created_by,created_at FROM ai_hr_interview_set s WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate} AND version=(SELECT MAX(v.version) FROM ai_hr_interview_set v WHERE v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.id=s.id) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id

SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,position_id,version,status,payload,provenance,cache_key,created_by,created_at FROM ai_hr_interview_set WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND cache_key=#{key} AND status='READY' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,tenant_id,set_id,set_version,interviewer_id,expires_at,status,created_by FROM ai_hr_interview_assignment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_interview_assignment SET status='REVOKED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,user_id,expires_at,status FROM ai_hr_contact_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_contact_grant SET status='CONSUMED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at>#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT id,action,actor_id,subject_ref,department_id,occurred_at FROM ai_hr_audit WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND department_id IN ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_hr_audit WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND department_id IN
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_candidate SET status='DELETING',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE ai_hr_contact_grant SET status='REVOKED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,department_id,status,step,attempts,next_attempt_at,created_at,failure_code FROM ai_hr_deletion_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}

SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,department_id,status,step,attempts,next_attempt_at,created_at,failure_code FROM ai_hr_deletion_job WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=#{now} ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_deletion_job SET status=CASE WHEN #{attempts}>=6 THEN 'BLOCKED' ELSE 'RETRY' END,attempts=#{attempts},next_attempt_at=#{next},failure_code=#{code} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')
UPDATE ai_hr_candidate SET expires_at=#{expires},consent_policy_id=#{policy},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,set_id,set_version,user_id,assignment_id,format,payload,grant_id,expires_at,status FROM ai_hr_interview_export WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id,tenant_id,set_id,set_version,user_id,assignment_id,format,payload,grant_id,expires_at,status FROM ai_hr_interview_export WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND grant_id=#{grant}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_interview_export SET status='CONSUMED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND status='READY' AND expires_at>#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN request_hash=#{hash} THEN result_ref ELSE '!CONFLICT' END FROM ai_hr_talent_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND route=#{route} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_deletion_job SET step=#{nextStep},status='PENDING',attempts=0,next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,failure_code=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND step=#{oldStep} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_hr_fact_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_candidate SET status='DELETED',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{candidate} AND status='DELETING'
UPDATE ai_hr_deletion_job SET status='DELETED',failure_code=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND step='FILES' AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY')

UPDATE ai_hr_interview_assignment SET status='REVOKED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='ACTIVE' AND set_id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_hr_interview_set WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate})

UPDATE ai_hr_interview_export SET status='REVOKED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='READY' AND set_id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_hr_interview_set WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_hr_candidate WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at<=#{now} ORDER BY expires_at,id LIMIT 100
SELECT DISTINCT candidate_id FROM ai_hr_matching_result WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND position_id=#{position} AND status NOT IN ('REVOKED','DELETED')
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_hr_candidate_merge SET source_ids=#{sources},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id AS snapshot_id,candidate_id,resume_version_id,version,created_at FROM ai_hr_fact_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id IN #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id

SELECT id AS result_id,candidate_id,position_id,config_version,business_status,status,created_at FROM ai_hr_matching_result WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id IN #{id} AND position_id IN #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id

SELECT candidate_id,wait_until FROM ai_hr_source_authorization WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND continuation_state='WAITING' AND wait_until>#{now} AND candidate_id IN #{id} ORDER BY wait_until,candidate_id
SELECT config_json FROM ai_hr_interview_generation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND set_id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_hr_interview_generation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND set_id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_hr_interview_set WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND candidate_id=#{candidate})
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,candidate_id,resume_version_id,version,facts_json,created_by,created_at FROM ai_hr_fact_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id IN #{id}
